player_points#pp-bucket-mixing.detail: Not closed. The mechanical clean-up is done (stage s7, bench inputs and bench text removed from player_points; nba.combo_component_marginals detached; benchmark inputs set to context; nba.starters_pit attached; team bench model and ledger live in game_overtime_and_team_events). But the filing itself rests on an inference: the only evidence is the series title 'NBA Bench Points' and scope 'Bench Points', no market has ever been listed, and its terms file BASKETBALLENTITYSTAT.pdf is also the terms file of player-prop series (KXNBAPTS, KXNBAREB), so the earlier 'team-entity stat' claim was wrong and is withdrawn. Missing evidence: the text of BASKETBALLENTITYSTAT.pdf (assets.kalshi.com is blocked from the research session) and the rules of a listed KXNBABENCHPTS market, which would say whether the entity is a team's bench total or a named player as a bench player. Both records state the entity as unresolved; the model sits in game_overtime_and_team_events because the quantity (non-starter points) is an aggregate, with player-level inputs already available here if the reading turns out to be per player.
